comparison.objective: Extract a wine cork while keeping the bottle in its cradle.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually stabilize the bottle, engage and turn a corkscrew, then pull against high axial resistance.
comparison.success_condition: Cork fully out and moved away while the bottle stays within cradle tolerances; partial credit tracks engagement and extraction.
comparison.reason: Although it uses a narrow tool and bimanual force control, its mechanism is threaded engagement and continuous extraction, not impulsive fracture and recovery of detached tangs.
